docs.title: Introduction
docs.text: OldAS is a library designed to allow async-friendly interaction with the API for TheOldReader.

docs.title: Installing
docs.text:
oldas is available from pypi and can be installed with pip or similar Python package tools:

$ pip install oldas

docs.title: clean_categories staticmethod
docs.text:
clean_categories(
    categories: Iterable[str],
) -> list[State | str]

Clean up a collection of categories.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default Iterable[str]

The categories to clean up.

required

Returns:

Type Description list[State | str]

The cleaned categories.

The incoming list of categories will simply be a list of strings, but each of them may refer to a folder or a state, etc. This method will clean the list, turning relevant values into their specific type.

Note

For the moment only values matching a State will be turned into their related type.
